This demonstrates a bounded improvement in warehouse-source and warehouse-backend presentation behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds a new dictionary, FILE_FORMAT_READ_HINTS, containing human-readable guidance for column-read failures, and its registration in the shared API and warehouse-source facade.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a lookup table for warehouse-source backend to return format-specific help messages when column detection fails.

observations.behavior: Imports and registers FILE_FORMAT_READ_HINTS in warehouse-source facade API and warehouse presentation view, and its registration in warehouse-source facade API.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test, test_column_read_failure_returns_format_specific_guidance, that mocks a ClickHouse column-detection failure and asserts the response returns a 400 status, omits the raw exception, and includes the format-specific hint.
